title: LLM因果发现失败原因及干预式智能体解决方案
summary: 本文证明LLM在因果发现中存在根本性局限：监督微调、DPO和上下文学习均无法区分产生相似观测数据的因果图，且模型内部表示需无限增长才能解决。提出Agentic Causal Bayesian Optimization (A-CBO)，利用冻结语言模型作为干预预言机，外部贝叶斯循环在对数轮内收敛。在Corr2Cause和扩展基准上无需训练即可匹配或超越微调基线。
summary_en: Proves LLMs fundamentally fail at causal discovery due to a kernel obstruction theorem. Proposes Agentic Causal Bayesian Optimization (A-CBO) using frozen LLM as interventional oracle with external Bayesian loop, achieving provable convergence and outperforming fine-tuning on benchmarks up to 24 variables.
